description: OMENZ Pay Ready: can THIS wallet pay THIS x402 seller right now? Send wallet + the seller's url (or its 402). Checks a Base option exists, the wallet holds enough of that exact asset, the asset supports gasless EIP-3009 (what x402 exact needs), plain vs smart-contract wallet, payee on OFAC list. READY / CAUTION / NOT_READY with the fix. Never signs or pays. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/pay/ready, $0.002 via x402.)
